prompt: Which revision would preserve the most usable part of the recording’s sound while meeting the rules?
promptZh: 在符合規則下，怎樣修剪聲音能保留最多可用素材？

options.text: Keep the piano because the contributor composed it, but delete the bells.
options.zh: 因為鋼琴曲是投稿者寫的，所以保留鋼琴，刪除鐘聲。
options.whyZh: 規則不因自創曲而例外，反而可保留不蓋過語音的現場鐘聲。

options.text: Remove the piano and retain the bells with the words clear.
options.zh: 移除鋼琴聲，保留不會蓋過人聲的鐘聲。
options.whyZh: 鋼琴是加上的背景音樂，應去掉；現場鐘聲沒蓋過敘述，因此可用。

options.text: Remove both the piano and the bells because recordings cannot include any added or local sound.
options.zh: 鋼琴聲與鐘聲都移除，因錄音不可有外加或現場聲音。
options.whyZh: 外加背景音樂不准用，但只要聽得懂每個詞，就可留現場聲音。

options.text: Keep both but move the piano to a louder section.
options.zh: 兩種聲音都留著，但把鋼琴移到更大聲的段落。
options.whyZh: 移位置不能讓外加背景音樂變成可接受的現場聲音。

explanationZh: 鋼琴是加上的背景音樂，應去掉；現場鐘聲沒蓋過敘述，因此可用。
evidence: For the recorded format, do not add background music. / A place’s own sounds may stay in the recording if listeners can still hear every word. / The bells are clear but don’t drown out my words. / I recorded bells from the street and mixed in a short piano tune.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: For the recorded format, do not add background music.
A place’s own sounds may stay in the recording if listeners can still hear every word.
The bells are clear but don’t drown out my words.
I recorded bells from the street and mixed in a short piano tune.

vocabulary.note: 指某種聲音太大，以致另一個聲音聽不清楚。
